thread:
sam: FYI discovered a clear behavioral delta after int4 quant bring-up on the promptset we use for chat-quality. high-level: more cut-off completions and <50% score drop on a subset. :frowning:
maya: ugh. which model and which prompt subset?
sam: model=q4b-int4-v2 (the one we tested yesterday). failing subset appears to be 'clarification + long-context' (multi-turn), ~420 examples. ran quick eval vs fp16.
anita: can you paste the eval numbers? rough is fine.
sam: snippet:
```
metric: answer_completeness
fp16: 0.92
int4: 0.47
cases: 420
notes: failures are truncated / mid-sentence stops
```
logan: :eyes: that's pretty big. Did we change tokenizer or kv-cache handling in the quant path?
sam: no tokenizer changes. suspect quant kernel fused attention + rotary scaling edge-case. infra team flagged a tiny sequence-length padding difference earlier.
olivia: labeling-bot, can you spawn a microgolden (100 cases) from that subset and route to the usual golden labelers? we need ground truth to confirm whether outputs are actually wrong vs metric bug.
labeling-bot: spawned microgolden 100/420 -> assigned to "golden-ops" cohort. ETA 8h.
maya: while labels run, can we run a behavioral diff with outputs? i.e., sample pairs of fp16 vs int4 and highlight truncation lengths + token-level probs.
sam: doing that now. attaching short diff summary shortly.
ci-bot: quick smoke CI found no memory regressions but higher tail latency on int4 on longctx instances (+18ms p95).
anita: action items:
- sam: produce fp16 vs int4 paired diffs (10k tokens sample) and share examples (ASAP)
- maya: triage whether metric implementation could miscount when truncation happens (today)
- olivia: coordinate microgolden labels and escalate if majority >30% false-positives (i.e., labels say outputs fine)
- logan: open an infra ticket about padding/kv-cache differences and attach perf traces (ETA EOD)

sam: quick examples attached inline:
1) fp16: "...and then you should call the API with the header set to..."
   int4: "...and then you should call"
2) fp16: long explanation preserved
   int4: explanation present but stops at comma

maya: if labels indicate real quality drop, we should consider rolling back the int4 rollout for prod routes that hit multi-turn longctx until we fix.
anita: agree. also add a canary that routes 5% traffic to fp16 for those routes while we investigate.
olivia: labeling-bot will post interim results to this thread when 25/100 and 100/100 complete.
sam: thanks all — I'll post diffs in ~30m. tagging @logan for infra traces. :thumbsup:"
